topic.para: On &suselinux; 15, Rust is updated inside released Service Packs rather than only at Service Pack boundaries.

listitem.para: Releases are kept in sync with upstream, which occur every 6 weeks.
A 6-week window is provided to perform upgrades and find any potential issues.
Both supported versions are available in parallel in the Development Tools Module and undergo automated testing.

Rust is supported across both the General Support and the LTSS phases. Versions N and N-1 are maintained in the LTSS streams as well, starting with &suselinux; 15 SP3 LTSS. A single source package per Rust version is shared across all Service Packs.
